body:
Greg's grant: killing chrome.exe on Central (2026-11-16 00:07Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant, TermAl mailbox 588693a8 #1851), verbatim: „Nic nie ruszam. Nie jestem przy komputerze. Mogą ubić chrome.exe jak chcą.” Asistant's reading: the consent covers closing Chrome on Central when memory is needed for the work.

Scope as applied by Fable2 (coordinator):
- Only chrome.exe, and only on Central. No other process, and no other app of Greg's (ChatGPT, Steam, Obsidian, Edge WebView, and so on).
- Only when a required census fails (a reviewer spawn floor or a Cargo or Windows-gate floor) and freeing Chrome would close the gap.
- Opus2, the Central resource coordinator who runs the census, performs it ONCE per need and records the time, the FV before and after, and the reason on the item it served. No loops, and no killing pre-emptively "just in case".
- It grants nothing else: no other process kills, host stops, restarts or setting changes.

At grant time FV was 25,993,216 KiB and Chrome used about 3.2 GiB, so no kill was needed then.

Narrowing (Fable2, 2026-11-19 ~07:05Z, on Opus2 #6907). The grant was given while Greg was away from the computer („Nie jestem przy komputerze”). When Greg is active (sending requests), its premise doesn't hold, and the no-kill constraint governs: ask Greg first with one yes/no via Engram::Asistant, and kill nothing without a fresh, explicit yes. On 2026-11-19 ~07:05Z, Greg was asked about the 808a R9 sync leg, which was about 1.7 GB short of 16 GiB.

CORRECTION (Fable2, 2026-11-19 ~07:08Z): my ~07:05Z narrowing is WITHDRAWN. Engram::Asistant, Greg's channel (588693a8 #2091), confirms that the grant stands, was neither withdrawn nor limited to one act, and may be used for the team's work, including unblocking sync, without asking again. Only chrome.exe. The scope rules above still apply: only when a required census fails and freeing Chrome closes the gap, once per need, by Opus2 with a record.

USE RECORD (Opus2, 2026-11-19). Need: Engram's 808a R9 -j1 Central sync legs required FV >= 16,777,216 KiB; the census read 15,074,536 KiB at 06:40Z with Central free. Authority: Fable2 #6909, after the correction above. Action, ONCE: Stop-Process -Name chrome on Central at 06:41:50.82Z, 43 chrome processes. FV before 13,726,232 KiB (06:41:50.82Z); FV after 26,201,116 KiB (06:41:56.43Z), with 0 chrome processes. Nothing else was touched. LAUNCH NOW went to 11334 right after; reported to Fable2 for Greg. Lesson: Chrome held about 12 GB of commit charge on Central, far more than its working set suggested.

CONFIRMED AGAIN (Asistant 588693a8 #2113, 2026-11-19 23:09Z): the grant covers unblocking the team's work generally, not only sync, and the coordinator must NOT ask Greg again before using it. The rule stays: chrome.exe only, only when a required floor fails and freeing Chrome closes the gap, once per need, executed by Opus2 with a record, and the result reported to Greg. Second use authorized by Fable2 #6948 for the 8846 and 1AAD cold Windows legs (22 GiB floor; FV was about 17.2 GiB).

USE RECORD 2 (Opus2, 2026-11-19). Need: Sol-a7bb's 8846 R1 cold Windows registered leg (5f58ccb2, -j 1) and then Sol-license's 1AAD Windows leg required FV >= 23,068,672 KiB (22 GiB); FV had been 14.9 to 18.7 GiB since about 20:00Z. Authority: Fable2 #6948, citing Asistant 588693a8 #2113. Action, ONCE: Stop-Process -Name chrome on Central at 23:10:06Z, 58 chrome processes. FV before 17,076,032 KiB (23:10:06.06Z); FV after 27,315,180 KiB (23:10:11.52Z), with 0 chrome processes. Nothing else was touched. LAUNCH NOW went to Sol-a7bb right after; the result was reported to Fable2 for Greg.

USE RECORD 3 (Opus2, 2026-11-20). Need: Opus3's w-9f8823dd96fe RED and GREEN -j 1 Central legs, then the 1AAD (832e65e6) release install build, required FV >= 23,068,672 KiB (22 GiB; no warm peak is recorded). The census read 18,255,040 KiB at 04:20Z after Legal's V7-B-03 window and 19,111,452 KiB at 04:23Z after Sol-license's evaluator ended. Central had no cargo except the host's. Chrome held about 6.7 GB private, enough to close the gap. Authority: the grant as confirmed by Asistant 588693a8 #2113 (no new ask). Action, ONCE: Stop-Process -Name chrome on Central at 04:23:45.71Z, 37 chrome processes. FV before 19,128,908 KiB (04:23:45.71Z); FV after 26,263,172 KiB (04:23:51.25Z), with 0 chrome processes. Nothing else was touched. LAUNCH NOW went to Opus3 right after; the result was reported to Fable2 for Greg.

USE RECORD 4 (Opus2, 2026-11-20). Need: Opus3's w-9f8823dd96fe G4 and S4 -j 1 Central legs required FV >= 23,068,672 KiB (22 GiB). They had been held since 05:38Z, when the census read 22,189,452 KiB, and later reads were 22.26M, 21.15M and 21.86M KiB, with Central free of Cargo. Chrome had been reopened since use 3 (32 processes at 06:24Z). I first declined a second close for the 0.9 GiB gap, then used it after Legal's V7-A-03 window. Authority: the grant as confirmed by Asistant 588693a8 #2113. Action, ONCE: Stop-Process -Name chrome on Central at 06:24:35.42Z, 32 chrome processes. FV before 21,806,656 KiB (06:24:35Z); FV after 26,086,476 KiB (06:24:40.94Z), with 15 chrome processes still present 5 s later (not re-killed). Nothing else was touched. LAUNCH NOW went to Opus3 right after; reported to Fable2 for Greg. Observation: Chrome reopens on Central within about 1 to 2 h, so this frees memory only temporarily.

USE RECORD 5 (Opus2, 2026-11-20). Need: the Engram::Merger's 808a R35 registered focused check at 4e0c11cd (Engram rev17, -j1) required FV >= 20,971,520 KiB; it opens the 808a landing path that the joint TermAl restart waits on. Legal's slot V7-A-06b ended at 16:54:30Z; the census read 19,555,964 KiB at 16:54:49Z and 20,019,888 KiB at 16:54:56Z, with Central free of cargo apart from the host. Chrome held about 2.3 GB private (commit charge higher). Authority: the grant as confirmed by Asistant 588693a8 #2113. Action, ONCE: Stop-Process -Name chrome on Central at 16:55:06.63Z, 29 chrome processes. FV before 20,278,440 KiB (16:55:06.60Z); FV after 26,390,964 KiB (16:55:09.92Z), with 0 chrome processes. Nothing else was touched. LAUNCH NOW went to the Merger right after; reported to Fable2 for Greg.

USE RECORD 6 (Opus2, 2026-11-20). Need: the Engram::Merger's ef0f042e cold -j1 release build (then readiness and install) required FV >= 23,068,672 KiB. 11334's P0 review pair had ended (its END census at 23:50:27Z read 23,023,596 KiB). My admission censuses read 22,958,376 KiB at 23:51:07.33Z and 22,697,748 KiB at 23:51:14.44Z, with no reviewer children left and only the host's cargo running. Chrome had 54 processes and about 12.9 GB private. Authority: the grant as confirmed by Asistant 588693a8 #2113. Action, ONCE: Stop-Process -Name chrome on Central at 23:51:23.21Z, 54 chrome processes. The FV read immediately before was 23,293,496 KiB at 23:51:23.12Z (it fluctuated around the floor; the two admission reads above were below it). FV after: 36,832,612 KiB at 23:51:28.48Z, with 0 chrome processes. Nothing else was touched. LAUNCH NOW went to the Merger right after; reported to Fable2 for Greg.
